disc-solid-line.alt: Left: the region between the parabola y = x² and the line y = 1, from x = −1 to 1, shaded, with y = 1 dashed as the axis of rotation and one thin vertical rectangle from the parabola up to the axis, of length 1 − x². Right: the solid made by revolving the region about y = 1, shaped like a lemon, with the axis through its center and one disc highlighted in blue whose radius is r = 1 − x². Below: V = the integral from −1 to 1 of π(1 − x²)² dx = 16π/15.
